correctness.rationale: For all m>=2 the proof computes exact all-triple inclusion ratios using the affine difference rank, an exact flat Walsh spectrum by factoring into m two-bit sums, and exactly Rademacher centered sampling totals; common sample mean and variance follow from the t<=2 inclusion ratios. The SRSWOR count is hypergeometric with mean N/4+sqrt(N)/4 and variance N/16; the standard hypergeometric CLT yields normality; Portmanteau then makes SRSWOR mass at {-1,+1} vanish, so TV tends to one. Boundary N=16 and variance normalization independently reconstructed; exact finite checker executed for N=16,64,256, all inclusion triples at N=16. Finite checks are not offered as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Resolves the first not previously established case r=3 of Chen 2026 explicitly stated fixed-order inclusion conjecture; bounded deterministic population and exactly half-size designs preclude rare-event or heavy-tail pathologies. Equal first three inclusion orders yet limiting sampling laws are exactly discrete versus Gaussian and even become maximally separated in total variation, a substantial obstruction for CLT transfer and higher-order survey-design diagnostics. Not merely a parameter substitution of the order-two construction; it uses a distinct 3-design and a bent-function population. No theorem for r>=4 or universal CLT criterion is claimed.
